newsitem.title: UK: Edge makes 15.45 mln stg retail investment.
newsitem.headline: Edge makes 15.45 mln stg retail investment.

text.p: British retail estate group Edge Properties Plc said on Tuesday it acquired two retail investments for a total 15.45 million stg in cash.

The main purchase -- a 75,000 sq ft ASDA superstore and three adjoining retail units totalling 3,750 sq ft also let to ASDA, in Glasgow, Scotland -- is being acquired for 11 million stg from PDFM Ltd. It currently generates 676,000 stg in rent annually.
Edge is also buying three retail units in Milton Keynes, covering 24,500 sq ft, from Haymills Property Investments Ltd for 4.45 million stg with current rental income of 306,000 stg a year.
